question: Will "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" beat "Avengers: Endgame" record domestic opening weekend box-office takings (actuals)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the officially reported domestic (US & Canada) 3-day opening weekend actual gross for "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" exceeds $357.1 million, as reported by Box Office Mojo or Boxoffice Pro.
- "No": Wins if the officially reported domestic (US & Canada) 3-day opening weekend actual gross for "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" is $357.1 million or less, as reported by Box Office Mojo or Boxoffice Pro.

Clarifications:
- The benchmark figure of $357.1 million is "Avengers: Endgame"'s confirmed domestic 3-day opening weekend actual (April 26–28, 2019). Only the 3-day actual (Friday–Sunday) is used for comparison; Thursday preview earnings are excluded from both figures unless they are folded into the official 3-day actual reported by the source.
- "Domestic" means the United States and Canada combined, consistent with standard industry reporting.
